steps.description:
The program plays continuously until the stop Button in the blockly is pressed
The display text must be interchangeable without stopping the program

Show that your robot can perform the following using color sensor:
1. When color sensor detects green color, the robot will display "Green" on the LCD
2. When color sensor detects other color, the robot will display "Not Green" on the LCD

Hint:
1. Return Color Value / Return Color Name
